The tests that used the @Deprecated CachedSelfSignedCertificate/SelfSignedCertificate (not ported, recorded by the lead) use a nested SelfSignedCertificateBundle that caches the X509Bundle that SelfSignedCertificate's CertificateBuilderCertGenerator builds by default (self-signed CA "CN=localhost", RSA 2048): certificate()/privateKey() are its PEM files (ToTempCertChainPem/ToTempPrivateKeyPem), cert() its certificate and key() its BCL key object (docs/pkitesting-porting.md). ChannelFuture/ChannelPromise/Promise/Future are Task/TaskCompletionSource (sync()/syncUninterruptibly() awaits, await()/awaitUninterruptibly() awaits with ConfigureAwaitOptions.SuppressThrowing | ContinueOnCapturedContext (xUnit1030), cause() a CauseOf helper, isSuccess() IsCompletedSuccessfully); the bootstrap API is asynchronous (BindAsync/ConnectAsync), new InetSocketAddress(0) is the wildcard IPEndPoint and the clients connect to it through the loopback address as the JDK does (docs/handler-porting.md, "Socket tests"). @Timeout(value, MILLISECONDS) is the Timeout of the [Fact]/[Theory] (async tests; a test whose helper waits with TestContext.Current.CancellationToken disables xUnit1069 with a reason), CountDownLatch is CountdownEvent with a CountDown helper that ignores a zero count, LinkedBlockingQueue is BlockingCollection (take() Take, poll(timeout) TryTake), ConcurrentLinkedQueue ConcurrentQueue, AtomicBoolean/AtomicReference the Common types, Thread.sleep Task.Delay, (long, TimeUnit) TimeSpan, and anonymous classes are named nested classes. OpenSSL/Conscrypt providers and tests are library-not-ported (owner decision 2026-11-24). Per test: the anonymous SslHandler/EmbeddedChannel/handler subclasses are nested classes (the isActive() override reads a flag set from a primary-constructor parameter before the base constructor runs); ch.write(msg).get() is the awaited Task, which throws the UnsupportedMessageTypeException itself (no ExecutionException); the duplex handler of testNonApplicationDataFailureFailsQueuedWrites returns a TaskCompletionSource Task as the write promise. A server-mode SSLEngine of the default SSLContext has no key material, while SslStream refuses a server without certificate when authentication starts (NotSupportedException "The server mode SSL must use a certificate with the associated private key", measured), so newServerModeSSLEngine() carries the cached test certificate as ServerCertificateContext. SslProtocols.SSL_v3 (deprecated, not ported) is its text "SSLv3". The connect listener that writes "before fireChannelActive is called" (testHandshakeFailedByWriteBeforeChannelActive, testHandshakeTimeoutFlushStartsHandshake) is a first handler that writes from channelActive before passing the event on, because the Transport's connect Task runs its continuations asynchronously (docs/handler-porting.md, "Listener timing"); AssertionError is UnreachableException. testHandshakeFailBeforeWritePromise runs its write listener on IdleStateHandler.ExecutorTaskScheduler(ctx) (at once on the event loop, as DefaultPromise does) so the failed write precedes the close event (a thread-pool continuation raced with it, measured). The X509ExtendedTrustManager of testHandshakeFailureOnlyFireExceptionOnce is a RemoteCertificateValidationCallback returning false (a trust manager rejects by throwing CertificateException, which JSSE turns into an alert; a callback rejects by returning false, after which SslStream sends the fatal alert, while an exception thrown by the callback propagates without one, SslStream.Protocol.cs). Adapted assertions (measured SslStream behaviour, CLR comments): testIncompleteWriteDoesNotCompletePromisePrematurely asserts finishAndReleaseAll() false, because SslStream writes no user_canceled/close_notify alert for a handshake closed before it completed; testHandshakeFailureOnlyFireExceptionOnce asserts that the server handshake succeeded, because SslStream validates the server certificate after its handshake completed, and the client's alert then fails the server's first read (the single DecoderException). testHandshakeFailureCipherMissmatch* skip on Windows (CipherSuitesPolicy unsupported, NewHandler throws PlatformNotSupportedException). testIncorrectLength relies on the SslHandler fix of this wave (a record shorter than the 5-byte header is BUFFER_UNDERFLOW, as in the JDK engine). The not-applicable tests' original comments are kept in CLR comment blocks at their places.

ChannelFuture/ChannelPromise/Promise/Future are Task/TaskCompletionSource (sync()/syncUninterruptibly() awaits, await()/awaitUninterruptibly() awaits with ConfigureAwaitOptions.SuppressThrowing | ContinueOnCapturedContext (xUnit1030), cause() a CauseOf helper, isSuccess() IsCompletedSuccessfully); the bootstrap API is asynchronous (BindAsync/ConnectAsync), new InetSocketAddress(0) is the wildcard IPEndPoint and the clients connect to it through the loopback address as the JDK does (docs/handler-porting.md, "Socket tests"). @Timeout(value, MILLISECONDS) is the Timeout of the [Fact]/[Theory] (async tests; a test whose helper waits with TestContext.Current.CancellationToken disables xUnit1069 with a reason), CountDownLatch is CountdownEvent with a CountDown helper that ignores a zero count, LinkedBlockingQueue is BlockingCollection (take() Take, poll(timeout) TryTake), ConcurrentLinkedQueue ConcurrentQueue, AtomicBoolean/AtomicReference the Common types, Thread.sleep Task.Delay, (long, TimeUnit) TimeSpan, and anonymous classes are named nested classes. OpenSSL/Conscrypt providers and tests are library-not-ported (owner decision 2026-11-24). Per test: the anonymous SslHandler/EmbeddedChannel/handler subclasses are nested classes (the isActive() override reads a flag set from a primary-constructor parameter before the base constructor runs); ch.write(msg).get() is the awaited Task, which throws the UnsupportedMessageTypeException itself (no ExecutionException); the duplex handler of testNonApplicationDataFailureFailsQueuedWrites returns a TaskCompletionSource Task as the write promise. A server-mode SSLEngine of the default SSLContext has no key material, while SslStream refuses a server without certificate when authentication starts (NotSupportedException "The server mode SSL must use a certificate with the associated private key", measured), so newServerModeSSLEngine() carries the cached test certificate as ServerCertificateContext. SslProtocols.SSL_v3 (deprecated, not ported) is its text "SSLv3". The connect listener that writes "before fireChannelActive is called" (testHandshakeFailedByWriteBeforeChannelActive, testHandshakeTimeoutFlushStartsHandshake) is a first handler that writes from channelActive before passing the event on, because the Transport's connect Task runs its continuations asynchronously (docs/handler-porting.md, "Listener timing"); AssertionError is UnreachableException. testHandshakeFailBeforeWritePromise runs its write listener on IdleStateHandler.ExecutorTaskScheduler(ctx) (at once on the event loop, as DefaultPromise does) so the failed write precedes the close event (a thread-pool continuation raced with it, measured). The X509ExtendedTrustManager of testHandshakeFailureOnlyFireExceptionOnce is a RemoteCertificateValidationCallback returning false (a trust manager rejects by throwing CertificateException, which JSSE turns into an alert; a callback rejects by returning false, after which SslStream sends the fatal alert, while an exception thrown by the callback propagates without one, SslStream.Protocol.cs). Adapted assertions (measured SslStream behaviour, CLR comments): testIncompleteWriteDoesNotCompletePromisePrematurely asserts finishAndReleaseAll() false, because SslStream writes no user_canceled/close_notify alert for a handshake closed before it completed; testHandshakeFailureOnlyFireExceptionOnce asserts that the server handshake succeeded, because SslStream validates the server certificate after its handshake completed, and the client's alert then fails the server's first read (the single DecoderException). testHandshakeFailureCipherMissmatch* skip on Windows (CipherSuitesPolicy unsupported, NewHandler throws PlatformNotSupportedException). testIncorrectLength relies on the SslHandler fix of this wave (a record shorter than the 5-byte header is BUFFER_UNDERFLOW, as in the JDK engine). The not-applicable tests' original comments are kept in CLR comment blocks at their places.

notApplicableMethods.reason: The test asserts SSLEngine.isOutboundDone() of an engine from SslContext.newEngine(...): newEngine is not ported (owner decision 2026-11-24, no SSLEngine facade) and SslStream has no outbound-done member (SslHandler keeps the state in a private flag; SslStream.CanWrite is false for an unauthenticated stream before and after the close).

review.scope: Ported 1:1 (same method names, first letter upper case) on Netty.NET.Handler.Ssl, whose SslHandler drives System.Net.Security.SslStream (owner decisions 2026-11-24, docs/handler-ssl-design.md). An SSLEngine of SSLContext.getDefault() is the SslClientAuthenticationOptions/SslServerAuthenticationOptions that SslHandler(options) takes (a JDK engine without setUseClientMode is in server mode, TransportContext "new SSLConfiguration(sslContext, false)"), SSLException/SSLHandshakeException/SSLProtocolException are AuthenticationException (ssl design decision 3), CertificateException/SignatureException are CryptographicException (ssl wave 1), and the session facts of engine().getSession() come from the internal SslHandler.Engine() (SslStream). The tests that used the @Deprecated CachedSelfSignedCertificate/SelfSignedCertificate (not ported, recorded by the lead) use a nested SelfSignedCertificateBundle that caches the X509Bundle that SelfSignedCertificate's CertificateBuilderCertGenerator builds by default (self-signed CA "CN=localhost", RSA 2048): certificate()/privateKey() are its PEM files (ToTempCertChainPem/ToTempPrivateKeyPem), cert() its certificate and key() its BCL key object (docs/pkitesting-porting.md). ChannelFuture/ChannelPromise/Promise/Future are Task/TaskCompletionSource (sync()/syncUninterruptibly() awaits, await()/awaitUninterruptibly() awaits with ConfigureAwaitOptions.SuppressThrowing | ContinueOnCapturedContext (xUnit1030), cause() a CauseOf helper, isSuccess() IsCompletedSuccessfully); the bootstrap API is asynchronous (BindAsync/ConnectAsync), new InetSocketAddress(0) is the wildcard IPEndPoint and the clients connect to it through the loopback address as the JDK does (docs/handler-porting.md, "Socket tests"). @Timeout(value, MILLISECONDS) is the Timeout of the [Fact]/[Theory] (async tests; a test whose helper waits with TestContext.Current.CancellationToken disables xUnit1069 with a reason), CountDownLatch is CountdownEvent with a CountDown helper that ignores a zero count, LinkedBlockingQueue is BlockingCollection (take() Take, poll(timeout) TryTake), ConcurrentLinkedQueue ConcurrentQueue, AtomicBoolean/AtomicReference the Common types, Thread.sleep Task.Delay, (long, TimeUnit) TimeSpan, and anonymous classes are named nested classes. OpenSSL/Conscrypt providers and tests are library-not-ported (owner decision 2026-11-24). Per test: the anonymous SslHandler/EmbeddedChannel/handler subclasses are nested classes (the isActive() override reads a flag set from a primary-constructor parameter before the base constructor runs); ch.write(msg).get() is the awaited Task, which throws the UnsupportedMessageTypeException itself (no ExecutionException); the duplex handler of testNonApplicationDataFailureFailsQueuedWrites returns a TaskCompletionSource Task as the write promise. A server-mode SSLEngine of the default SSLContext has no key material, while SslStream refuses a server without certificate when authentication starts (NotSupportedException "The server mode SSL must use a certificate with the associated private key", measured), so newServerModeSSLEngine() carries the cached test certificate as ServerCertificateContext. SslProtocols.SSL_v3 (deprecated, not ported) is its text "SSLv3". The connect listener that writes "before fireChannelActive is called" (testHandshakeFailedByWriteBeforeChannelActive, testHandshakeTimeoutFlushStartsHandshake) is a first handler that writes from channelActive before passing the event on, because the Transport's connect Task runs its continuations asynchronously (docs/handler-porting.md, "Listener timing"); AssertionError is UnreachableException. testHandshakeFailBeforeWritePromise runs its write listener on IdleStateHandler.ExecutorTaskScheduler(ctx) (at once on the event loop, as DefaultPromise does) so the failed write precedes the close event (a thread-pool continuation raced with it, measured). The X509ExtendedTrustManager of testHandshakeFailureOnlyFireExceptionOnce is a RemoteCertificateValidationCallback returning false (a trust manager rejects by throwing CertificateException, which JSSE turns into an alert; a callback rejects by returning false, after which SslStream sends the fatal alert, while an exception thrown by the callback propagates without one, SslStream.Protocol.cs). Adapted assertions (measured SslStream behaviour, CLR comments): testIncompleteWriteDoesNotCompletePromisePrematurely asserts finishAndReleaseAll() false, because SslStream writes no user_canceled/close_notify alert for a handshake closed before it completed; testHandshakeFailureOnlyFireExceptionOnce asserts that the server handshake succeeded, because SslStream validates the server certificate after its handshake completed, and the client's alert then fails the server's first read (the single DecoderException). testHandshakeFailureCipherMissmatch* skip on Windows (CipherSuitesPolicy unsupported, NewHandler throws PlatformNotSupportedException). testIncorrectLength relies on the SslHandler fix of this wave (a record shorter than the 5-byte header is BUFFER_UNDERFLOW, as in the JDK engine). The not-applicable tests' original comments are kept in CLR comment blocks at their places.

caseMappings.adaptation: Every JUnit method is a [Fact] or [Theory] with the same name (first letter upper case); internal members are visible through InternalsVisibleTo. X509Certificate.getInstance is X509CertificateLoader.LoadCertificate and Assumptions.abort on a CertificateException is Assert.Skip on a CryptographicException; the getters are compared through the BCL X509Certificate members (GetSerialNumber, Issuer, Subject, GetEffectiveDateString/GetExpirationDateString); getVersion and the signature algorithm getters have no member, so GetRawCertData and the key algorithm are compared instead.

caseMappings.adaptation: Every JUnit method is a [Fact] or [Theory] with the same name (first letter upper case); internal members are visible through InternalsVisibleTo. caseMappings.adaptation: Source scenarios, inputs and assertions. ChannelFuture is the Task of WriteAsync/WriteAndFlushAsync (isDone(), isSuccess() and cause() are IsCompleted, IsCompletedSuccessfully and the inner exception; assertInstanceOf is Assert.IsAssignableFrom and RuntimeException is Exception); syncUninterruptibly() is an await, awaitUninterruptibly() an await with SuppressThrowing | ContinueOnCapturedContext (xUnit1030), addListener a ContinueWith continuation and CountDownLatch.await(10, SECONDS) a Task.WhenAny with a 10 second delay. ByteArrayInputStream and Channels.newChannel(...) are MemoryStream, File is FileInfo, RandomAccessFile and its FileChannel are FileStream, EOFException is EndOfStreamException, ISO_8859_1/US_ASCII are Encoding.Latin1/ASCII, File.deleteOnExit() is an AppDomain.ProcessExit handler (as the Transport SocketFileRegionSourceTest), and AtomicInteger/AtomicBoolean are StrongBox values or int fields updated with Interlocked/Volatile. The anonymous ChunkedInput and ChannelOutboundHandlerAdapter classes are named nested classes whose promise.setFailure/tryFailure/setSuccess are returned Tasks; their @Deprecated readChunk(ChannelHandlerContext) overrides are not ported with the interface member. The test methods pass TestContext.Current.CancellationToken to the channel operations (xUnit1051).

caseMappings.adaptation: Every JUnit method is a [Fact] with the same name (first letter upper case); the anonymous handlers are named nested classes. The tests drive the EmbeddedChannel frozen clock as Java does; advanceTimeBy(n, unit) takes a TimeSpan, and anyNotIdle's delayInNanos / 2L + 1L nanoseconds round up to the next 100 ns tick (500,000,100 ns), which keeps the action strictly after half the idle time. The functional interface Action is a delegate of the same name; AssertJ assertThat(...).isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1) is Assert.True; asserts with messages use XunitAssertMessages.AssertM. ObservableChannel overrides the per-message EmbeddedChannel doWrite(msg) with a Task that stays pending, which keeps AbstractChannel's drain at the first flushed message so every flushed message stays in the ChannelOutboundBuffer, as the empty Java doWrite(ChannelOutboundBuffer) does; doClose() completes it so the drain releases its reference once the channel closes. unsafe().outboundBuffer() is the OutboundBuffer property and consume()/consumePart() are internal (a C# outer class cannot reach private members of a nested class). The idle-state tests depend on the synchronous write listener of IdleStateHandler (see its entry).
